info.name: Byruha API v1
info.description:
Postman documentation for Byruha API v1. Includes Events APIs, customer operations, event interests, and the authenticated UChat Store integration for catalog, cart, orders, and Thawani checkout. Includes child-account cart/order selection, wallet balance/history, wallet top-ups, and browser confirmation for wallet purchases.
Customer, family, booking, payment and assistant-interest endpoints now require the trusted server-side UChat bearer token. Public events remain readable without a token. Password updates via the customer API are prohibited. Linked minor accounts must use the account lifecycle workflow before parent/family deletion (409 minor_account_lifecycle_required).
UChat onboarding: find/create a family member first; open its minor profile; deliver guardian OTP; obtain explicit consent and verify; send the signed activation link for the child to set a password on the website. Never use an outbound OTP to auto-verify without the guardian response.

request.description: Creates a pending_review booking for the customer. Required fields: event_id, family_member_ids. Optional: coupon_code. The event must be published, family members must belong to this customer, and coupon_code must match an active, unexpired coupon for the selected event and family member count with remaining usage. Coupon codes are normalized by the API, so casing and surrounding spaces are not important. If the coupon beats the automatic discount, the response snapshots coupon_id, coupon_code, discount_source="coupon", discount_name, discount_amount, and total, and consumes one coupon use for this booking. Rejected or cancelled bookings release that coupon use. If an automatic discount is larger than the coupon, discount_source remains "discount" and coupon_id/coupon_code are null.

request.description: Creates a full-payment schedule when the booking has no payment schedule, or selects an event payment plan when payment_plan_id is provided. Then initiates the requested booking_installment_id, or the next pending installment when omitted/null. For positive balances, returns a pending Thawani payment with checkout_url. If a coupon or discount covered the full balance and total is 0.000, the API settles the installment immediately as a paid manual payment with checkout_url=null; do not open a payment webview in that case. Booking must belong to the customer, be approved, have signed contracts, and the customer profile must be complete.

item.name: UChat Store
item.description:
Authenticated server-to-server Store API used by UChat. Every request requires the configured Bearer token. Customer-scoped requests use X-WhatsApp-Phone as the trusted identity. Prices, VAT, totals, availability, and ownership are always calculated by the server.

Wallet flow: set the guardian WhatsApp phone and store_minor_profile_id; the guardian must own the active child profile and have a verified phone. Enable WALLETS_ENABLED on the server. Read the wallet, initiate a Thawani top-up, and open checkout_url in the browser. Use the same minor_profile_id throughout cart and order requests. Create a wallet order and open payment.confirmation_url in the browser as the authenticated guardian to approve payment; UChat cannot debit directly. Pickup only; email is optional. Guardian phone OTP has optional endpoints: skip them unless GET account.phone_verification_required=true and phone_verified=false; wallet confirmation and refunds use the website. New minor accounts do not require a minor OTP. Create with consent_accepted=true, then share activation_url for password setup. Recover lost/expired links with the activation-link endpoint.

Use a new idempotency key for each new order or top-up, retaining it for retries of that same operation. Do not reuse a key for another amount or child. All monetary response fields ending in _baisa are integer baisa (1000 = OMR 1).
Account onboarding and verification use the same trusted token and guardian X-WhatsApp-Phone. Accept-Language: ar or en. Errors retain code and add reasons[field] machine-readable codes when available.

Returns one published product by slug, including category and purchasable options. Returns product_not_found when the product is missing or not public.

Creates an order from the current cart, reserves tracked inventory, snapshots prices and VAT, and initiates Thawani checkout. Repeating the same Idempotency-Key for the same phone returns the same order. For scheduled pickup use pickup_type=scheduled and provide pickup_at. payment_method accepts thawani (default) or wallet. Set minor_profile_id to the child ID for child orders. Wallet orders return payment.method=wallet, payment.status=confirmation_required and payment.confirmation_url; no funds are debited by this endpoint. Thawani orders return payment.checkout_url. Order data includes payment_method and minor_profile_id. Email is optional.

item.name: Open minor account for family member

request.description: First select/create a family member. Show GET account consent_policy_text and obtain guardian approval before consent_accepted=true. Reuses stored name/birthdate; under 18 only. Returns 201 {data:{minor_profile_id,family_member_id,name,member_code,status:"pending_child_activation",direct_payment_enabled:false,wallet_spending_enabled:false},created:true,activation_url:"signed URL",expires_at:"ISO timestamp"}. Share activation_url with the child to set a password within 24 hours; do not collect passwords in UChat. No minor OTP or outbound webhook is needed. Retry returns 200 same profile, created:false, activation_url:null and does not invalidate the previous link. Recover missing links using Issue or renew minor activation link. Phone verification is optional by default. Only request an OTP when GET account returns phone_verification_required=true and phone_verified=false.

Expires in 24 hours; invalidates any previous activation link or minor OTP. Supports legacy pending_guardian_verification and pending_child_activation only. Active, suspended, deleted/inactive and other guardians accounts are rejected with 422. No OTP or outbound webhook required. Obtain guardian consent before calling. Throttle: 5/minute. Share the returned URL for browser password setup.

item.name: Wallets
item.description: Wallet workflow: select an active minor account; check GET account.phone_verification_required before requesting any phone OTP. The requirement defaults to false. Then view balance, initiate top-up, track the top-up reference, browse movements, and create a wallet order. Requests inherit the UChat Store bearer token. Account setup and OTP requests remain in UChat Store; cart preparation uses its cart requests. Confirm wallet orders using the returned website confirmation link.

request.description: Requires an owned active minor_profile_id and guardian phone verification only when GET account.phone_verification_required=true. Returns 200 with wallet_id, minor_profile_id, balance_baisa, currency, status, and the latest 50 movements (id, type, order_reference, credit_baisa, debit_baisa, balance_after_baisa, created_at). Use GET wallet/movements for paginated history. Also returns available_balance_baisa (unreserved spendable funds, not spending permission), reserved_balance_baisa and eligible_refund_baisa (unused eligible funds within the refund deadline; not a refund promise). 404 wallet_unavailable when wallets are disabled; 422 validation_failed for invalid identity, ownership, profile or verification. Bearer authentication is inherited from this folder.

Requires an owned active child and guardian phone verification only when GET account.phone_verification_required=true. amount_omr is an OMR decimal with at most 3 fractional digits, between 0.100 and 100000; configured server limits also apply. Returns 201 with top_up_reference, payment_reference, amount_baisa, currency, status, checkout_url and expires_at. Open checkout_url in the browser to pay through Thawani; wallet credit follows verified payment. Success/cancel callbacks are signed website URLs and require guardian login. Reusing the same key and amount for a pending checkout reuses the operation. Paid top-ups awaiting wallet credit, completed top-ups and mismatched key reuse are rejected. Returns 422 validation_failed, 404 wallet_unavailable when disabled, or 503 payment_unavailable for gateway failure.

Owned wallet only; unavailable reference returns 404 top_up_not_found. Read-only; does not retry provider payment/refund.
